title: Contract freshness and currentness evidence
official_findings: BDUK July 2026 contract page updated 20 July and snapshots data held 16 July.
Contracted premises are initial scope only; deferred scope may not be reflected.
Variable lag exists between contract signature/delivery and BDUK ingestion.
Contract figures are not directly comparable with official-statistics subsidy delivery counts.
January 2026 remains the latest verified premises-level OMR publication in the collection.
Ofcom Spring 2026 remains a January 2026 current coverage snapshot.
ONS postcode products remain geography/lifecycle context only.
